tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks, optionally filtered by collection, state and due-date range. Same parameters for every task service. Accepts multiple providers at once: results are grouped per provider in results[], and a failing provider only affects its own entry.

collection_id.description: Task collection ID from list_task_collections (a To Do list, or a ClickUp List). Omit to use the default collection: To Do's built-in list, or all tasks across the ClickUp workspace.

due_after.description: Only tasks due at or after this RFC3339 time

due_before.description: Only tasks due at or before this RFC3339 time

max_results.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 50)

page_token.description: Pagination token from the previous response

provider.description: Required. Task services to query, e.g. ["todo"] or ["todo","clickup"]; each requires the corresponding account to be connected. A plain string is also accepted for a single service.

status.description: Task state, normalized across services: 'open' or 'completed'

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Searches tasks by keyword in the task title. Neither service offers full-text search, so matching is done over recently fetched tasks — check coverage_note in the response before concluding a task does not exist.

collection_id.description: Task collection ID from list_task_collections (a To Do list, or a ClickUp List). Omit to use the default collection: To Do's built-in list, or all tasks across the ClickUp workspace.

due_after.description: Only tasks due at or after this RFC3339 time

due_before.description: Only tasks due at or before this RFC3339 time

max_results.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 50)

provider.description: Required. Task service: 'todo' (Microsoft To Do) or 'clickup' (ClickUp). Requires the corresponding account to be connected.

query.description: Keyword matched against the task title (case-insensitive)

status.description: Task state, normalized across services: 'open' or 'completed'

tools.description: Gets a single task by ID.

provider.description: Required. Task service: 'todo' (Microsoft To Do) or 'clickup' (ClickUp). Requires the corresponding account to be connected.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Creates a task. Same parameters for every task service.

assignees.description: Assignee user IDs (ClickUp only; To Do tasks are always personal and will return an error if set)

collection_id.description: Task collection ID from list_task_collections (a To Do list, or a ClickUp List). Omit to use the default collection: To Do's built-in list, or all tasks across the ClickUp workspace.

due.description: Due time in RFC3339, e.g. 2026-08-20T18:00:00+08:00 (same format for every service)

priority.description: Priority, normalized across services (To Do has no 'urgent' — it is stored as 'high')

due.description: Due time in RFC3339, e.g. 2026-08-20T18:00:00+08:00 (same format for every service)

priority.description: Priority, normalized across services (To Do has no 'urgent' — it is stored as 'high')
